decisions.reason: As a large, growing German machinery firm with in-house R&D and organizational slack, we would keep this close-to-core printer because its fit with our established marking systems and the industry's favorable growth means its early results need not exceed aspiration immediately to justify continued support.

We would keep this software module because it directly extends our installed base, supports the strategic move toward digitalization and traceability, and in a growing firm such adjacent software innovations are likely to remain above or near aspiration once learning effects are considered.

We would keep this inkjet coder because it builds on our existing technology and customer needs for marking difficult surfaces, and given strong internal capabilities and a growing market, any short-term uncertainty is better handled through continued problemistic search and refinement than withdrawal.
